name: DIVINATION
source:
A short game where you act as a fortune teller in a futuristic  world. Talk and listen to people's stories, then foresee their future using the runes they had drawn.

The result of your divination will stir the fate of human and robot alike.

[From the [url=https://mojiken.itch.io/divination]official site[/url]]
translation:
一款短游戏，你在未来世界中扮演算命先生。谈论并聆听人们的故事，然后使用他们绘制的符文来预见他们的未来。

你的占卜结果将搅动人类和机器人的命运。

[摘自[url=https://mojiken.itch.io/divination]官方网站[/url]]
